caption: The drawing depicts a black chest of drawers with three rows and three columns of decorative panels on the front. Each drawer front is divided into three sections: the left and right sections each contain a circular, flower-like motif composed of white, yellow, red, and black petal shapes inside a white-bordered black circle, and the central section features a diamond pattern alternating between black and red-orange shapes outlined in white. Smaller red-orange decorative motifs are situated between these sections. The chest has a rectangular top with a slightly lighter brown edge, straight black sides, and stands on four short legs with a straight apron connecting them at the base. The entire composition is centered on a plain, light beige background.
title: Blanket Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
